notes.title: Full version of Lesson Learned coming in May
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35377707/f430b8fe4c6bbd6bc98de34971ea0db46baab19d.png

Great news for every fan of tower defense games! The full version of Lesson Learned will be available on May 29, 2024, on Steam and Xbox!

Watch the teaser announcing the date of Lesson Learned:

https://youtu.be/RC2FGmXwU6E
In this hilarious tower defense game, Frank and a campaign led through different historical eras await you. Defend your mobile base with a succession of defense towers and distribute tasks among the minions - Frank's classmates.

You can play Lesson Learned in solo or cooperative mode. Invite friends and try your hand at split-screen campaign mode.

Play the free prologue Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth, which is now available. In it, you will learn the necessary mechanics and face the bloody Countess Elizabeth Batory. Also add Lesson Learned to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #49 - Full release launching tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Hello Gunslingers!

Full release of Gunslingers & Zombies is almost here - remember tomorrow is the day!

As the game launches you will also be able to join our livestream - 28.10.21, 05:00 PM CET - come hang out with the Community Managers as they will answer all your questions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/4f0897030299fbb7dabc94c8300d09db3c4015aa.jpg

As the game launches fully tomorrow we thought it's the high time to let you know about some clever tricks and objects you might want to use to give yourself an edge in the campaign against The Green that starts tomorrow. As that is the case we present you with few tips that could turn the tide of battle to your favour! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/b16d480f061f8599a8efafb777877e74d1f967bb.png

Make sure to be aware of barrels! They can be your biggest ally but also can spell your doom - depending on how you use them. If you shoot them they will explode and damage all nearby units. Keep in mind that enemies (or allies!) that are close to the barrel will receive more damage than those that are still in range but farther. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/4af18675a2af6ffe5d16fd04b60c0982d1aaaee3.png

Counter-attacking also goes both ways - to a certain degree. Zombies will try hitting you if you're in their range after you attacked them. That's only true for the situations where you failed to kill them with your attack. To emulate something a bit similar you can click on the defend button - as you do it, you will spend an action point and finish the action for a particular character but they will be able to shoot a zombie as soon as they enter the character's vision. It might be helpful if you prefer to let them come to you instead of charging them head-first! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/d2a1089ba503d6fdbf9e4d43de49293bdf35b1fd.png



Check out our new trailer for the full release below - a little taste of what's to come in full release! 

[previewyoutube=iaeNEPpxvBA;full][/previewyoutube]

As it's the last moment to act - make sure to let your friends know about the Community Challenge! Each and every participant matters and can make or break the whole challenge! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/85b6fbd7532c68c16bf7528e84ab29628731a63f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/7aee85cf6d048f563a418d71eb01daf55e775da7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/28c3204149cf3eea982f755de61da43bd9f700b3.png

Fingers crossed and good luck!

Remember - the game releases fully tomorrow! Do not miss it!

Kind regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #48 - 5 days to Full Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Gunslingers!

Make sure your gun is loaded and heart is brave enough to fight against the green menace!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/253b1cce123289aee30acc25fe58f98e59a19b46.jpg

It's only 5 days and you will be able to enjoy the full experience of Gunslingers & Zombies - new levels, opponents and locations are almost here and we just hope you're brave enough to fight your way through the obstalces we've prepared for you. Speaking of which - let's share some more information about the opponents that you will have to win against in new missions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/36858362b7152f0728afdc114bb5707e78144971.png

Hub is certainly a formidable opponent, very dangerous if you don't plan your actions with them in mind. After destroying them they will split into two separate zombies that might be smaller but are vicious nonetheless. They will being acting immediately on their turn meaning that you need to take into account whether you want to destroy hub at this particular moment or perhaps deal with it later and from a safe distance. The choice is - as always - solely yours! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/24b3bd6793ead3002b21f45eab8b60840e90ca6f.png

You might have felt that you're the hunter up until this point. But what if I told you that zombies also have their own hunters? Yes, indeed - some of them has evolved into an uncanny version of themselves and gained the ability to attack from distance changing them into a very crucial threat. Perhaps you'll need to prioritize getting rid of them first - or you might want to find a shelter after shooting once...

That's not all we've prepared for you but now let us also check the state of the Community Challenge! 

The goals have not been reached yet but no worries - you can still contribute to it even now - if you haven't joined the groups through the links below you certainly should do so in order to increase the probability of unlocking further rewards! 

Make sure to let your friends know about them too! Each and every participant matters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/85b6fbd7532c68c16bf7528e84ab29628731a63f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/7aee85cf6d048f563a418d71eb01daf55e775da7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/28c3204149cf3eea982f755de61da43bd9f700b3.png

Make sure to let your friends know about the challenge - we'll be updating you about the state of the challenge as it unfolds! Fingers crossed and good luck!

Remember - the game releases fully on 28.10.21! Mark the date in your calendar and do not miss it! 

Kind regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #44 - ”Upcoming patch”
notes.notes:
Hello Gunslingers!

Has it been a while, ain't it? They say as vast as Prairie is, all the roads eventually lead up to Saloon, so we have finally met again.

Today we bring some news. Big news. Zombies are back, now more relentless than ever.

Soon we will introduce Big Patch to the Gunslingers & Zombies, and this day marks the day we are calling the cavalry and moving on towards Full Release.

From now on we are back to Devloging development of the game, and those Devlogs should appear every second or third Friday.

Today we would like to share a list of upcoming changes with You. Currently, we are busy with playtesting this patch, and some shiny pieces of code still need to be put together.

Campaign 


 Modification of the tutorial and addition of new tutorial boards - improvements to present new mechanics and new types of zombies.

 Creation of 6 new missions - More story, more zombies and more shooting.

 Implementation of difficulty level - creating 3 difficulty levels: easy,
normal and hard.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/6ee13f47d477a870a0d5a81be951432def0a4327.jpg

Enemies
Addition of 3 new enemy classes

 "Hunter" Zombie, which attacks at a distance,
 "Boomer" Zombie, which when killed explodes with poisonous gas and deals damage friendly units (other zombies are immune),
 "Hub" Zombie, which after death spawns two smaller zombies of "Pocket" type,


Zombie Changes:

 Enemies now also have various amounts of Health in opposition to static 10 HP before.
 Zombie stats like Health, Speed or Damage now depend on chosen difficulty.
 Enemy Counter-attack - Adding mechanics for counter-attacking enemy units. During
attacking an enemy in melee, if the enemy is not killed, the enemy in retaliation will attack the character right after receiving damage. The mechanics will further enhance the
The mechanics will further enhance the gameplay experience and significantly influence the player's strategy,
 Improvement of the AI that spawns during the game


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/923a9c69b2f64065de3c78e06dd1859be43f7c15.png

Gameplay mechanics changes:

Adding interactive on-ground items:

 adding an exploding barrel which dealing area of effect damage to enemy and friendly units,
 adding an ammo crate, where heroes can replenish their ammo supply
 adding a bandages supply crate
 adding an explosive cart

Adding character interaction with a diagonal object:

 Standing diagonally from an interactive object will also be able to interact with the object.
 Gunslingers can also attack diagonally now.

Adding confirmation of character movement:

 adding a mechanic to confirm the path of a character's movement. The first LPM click marks the path the character is moving, and a second click in the same place confirms the character's movement.

Balancing changes of knife attack
 was a little OP. Now it's more in line with ranged weapons together with enemy HP changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/fd78544b0e06cb5a12c2a34ffe048e20bae6787e.png

Additionally
Improving the soundtrack:

 improving the sounds of some weapons,
 improving some of the sound effects that already exist in the game,
 adding sound effects to newly created mechanics

Modifying the UI when hovering the cursor over an enemy

 improving the visual effect of the UI, in which the information about the chance of
 damage chance and critical damage chance. Removal of zombie names and
 replacing them with zombie types.

Modification of the tutorial and addition of new tutorial boards

 improvements to present new mechanics and new types of zombies.

Introduction of several corrections and improvements, including:

  changing the colour of the first movement zone,
  adding an active counter-attack mode symbol to the UI,
  improved ESC function,
  Improved critical damage designation,


- Creation of keyboard shortcuts,

- Marking the number of actions on the sidebar

- Adding the ability to play in a window,

- Turning off grids during the attack cutscene

- Creation of new "goals," i.e. heal maximum Health, kill a zombie with a knife etc.

- Some more various minor fixes

And most probably some more changes are coming soon. Right now, it's hard to estimate new updates coming live, but it's weeks, not months, shooting at the calendar.


See You Next Friday and Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team

notes.title: Gunslingers & Zombies Devlog #43 - ”Friendly reminder” - 7 days to EA Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Gunslingers!

We're fast approaching an Early Access release date - we thought it to be the best time to recheck some of the basics!

As you're going to be put in charge of the cowboys and gunslingers appearing in the game very soon we believe it will not hurt to remind you about some of the general rules of the game that we hope you will have a lot of fun with! Let's collectively take some advice from... the game itself! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/85135867e9a7c986c50cc447939b2adffac8932b.png

Advice No. 1 - Zombies can't see you unless you are in the red zone of their sight. You can always check it if you simply mouse over the zombie. As long as you stay out of the zone their movements will be unfocused. Alternatively - if you enter the zone you might expect them to come crawling at you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/1f6ec487662b0e85e2efd970d396115cee8643f3.png
 
Advice No. 2 - Be mindful of your action points. You have two points that you need to share between moving and acting. If you sprinted (moved out of the green zone into yellow zone) your character will consume both action points leaving you without the possibility to do anything else. Rushing the zombie might work against you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/ec94d90a98e691a8c749d2095452ea7b677ebe36.png

Advice No. 3 - Check your opponents! You can learn their health points, you will see a hit chance of your own attack and many more! Be sure to search for the opportunities to flank the opponents in order to maximize your chances of survival and the chance to kill a zombie with one hit! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818656/874ec2fbb12ff9b9e3899d2297161e0fa13c90a8.png

Advice No. 4 - Be mindful of your teammates! Heal them when they need healing or simply move them back to allow them a much needed breather. Remember that you are commanding a whole team and not just a one character - as long as you keep them all relatively healthy your chances of winning do increase! 
 
Thank you for the continuous support and see you soon in the game itself!

Best regards,
Gunslingers and Zombies Team
